description: Run when you're not sure what an address is, before sending to it or passing it to another tool. SOL sent to a token or program address can be stuck for good. Says what any address is: a normal wallet, token account, token, program, stake account and more, with the key facts for each. Inputs: address: Any Solana address. network (optional): Which Solana network to read. Default "mainnet-beta" (real money). Cost: 25 free calls a day, then $0.01 USDC per call (x402). Full field-by-field docs: GET /api/tools/whats_this.

address.description: Any Solana address. Whatever address you're about to use.

network.description: Which Solana network to read. Default "mainnet-beta" (real money). Leave it out for mainnet. Use "devnet" only for test wallets.

name: whats_this
